rationale: The mass reads as a radial, multi-lobed spiked object that is coherent as a graphic silhouette in plan and isometric, but it does not sustain a gymnasium reading. A gym needs one dominant clear-span hall with a subordinate support spine and a legible roof/section that expresses span or daylight. Here the form fragments into overlapping wedge pieces, with no discernible long-span enclosure, no public court or undercut at the access edge, and no clear service-vs-hall hierarchy. The silhouette is energetic but program-misaligned; it feels closer to an abstract sculptural cluster or tower-derived rotation than to a usable sports hall. Because the dominant program relation is erased, program_fit_hard_pass fails.
